events.title: 맨체스터 유나이티드 beat 리버풀 3–1 at Old Trafford to leave the Merseysiders nine points behind leaders 아스널. 20-year-old midfielder Russell Beardsmore , starting for only the second time in the league, scored a second half equaliser for United before setting up a goal each for 브라이언 매클레어 and 마크 휴스 to wipe out 리버풀's lead.
루턴 타운 thrash 사우샘프턴 6–1 in the biggest win of the First Division season.
Neil Warnock leaves Scarborough to become manager of 노츠 카운티 , to replace John Barnwell , sacked a month ago.
맨체스터 시티 boost their Second Division promotion push with a £250,000 move for 셰필드 웬즈데이 midfielder Gary Megson .
서턴 유나이티드 , of the Conference, knock 코번트리 시티 out of the FA Cup with a shock 2–1 win in the third round. 미들즈브러 lose 2–1 at home to Fourth Division 그림즈비 타운 .
Struggling 웨스트햄 유나이티드 surprisingly beat 아스널 1–0 in an FA Cup third round replay at Highbury.
After just seven months at 뉴캐슬 유나이티드, goalkeeper 데이브 베선트 signs for Second Division leaders 첼시 in a £725,000 deal which contracts him to the Stamford Bridge club until 1994.
서턴 유나이티드's FA Cup adventure ends in the Fourth Round when they are hammered 8–0 by 노리치 시티. 브렌트퍼드 beat 맨체스터 시티 3–1.

아스널 remain top of the First Division, three points ahead of 노리치 시티. 코번트리 시티 are third, but 밀월 have slipped to seventh. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 are back in bottom place after failing to gain a single league point this month, and are level on points with 웨스트햄 유나이티드. 첼시 continue to lead the way in the Second Division, while 왓퍼드 now stand second, level on points with third placed 맨체스터 시티. 웨스트브로미치 앨비언, 블랙번 로버스 and 선덜랜드 complete the top six.
